notes: Design DNA: cinematic, glassmorphic, dark runwayML style; black canvas with animated magenta and cyan gradients, oversized display type (e.g., Satoshi, Inter, or custom bold sans), pill-shaped elements, glass blur, heavy shadow, extreme whitespace, pill buttons/inputs, section glass walls. Animation: Framer Motion: fade/scale-in, hover bounce, animated gradients, smooth scroll. Interaction: hover glows, glass blur, pill button bounce, motion-based transitions, animated section reveals. Color scheme: pure black with magenta/cyan gradients, runwayML cinematic.
